name: ANSI/IEEE adjustable-ratio transformer symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for adjustable-ratio transformer, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The adjustable transformer form identifies a documented change in winding ratio or connection. Its adjustment range and permissible operating condition must be supplied by the equipment record; an adjustment mark is not an on-load operating approval.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Locate the tap or adjustment connection before reading the supplied voltage.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Adjustable-ratio representation does not establish that adjustment is permitted while energised.
